# PureFlow Air & Chimney

## What PureFlow is
PureFlow Air & Chimney is an independent lead referral service for Greater Houston, Texas. PureFlow does not perform the cleaning or repair work. It connects homeowners with licensed local providers who inspect, quote, and do the job.

## Services and starting prices
Typical starting prices for standard residential jobs (final price confirmed in writing after the on-site visit):
- Air duct cleaning — from $299
- Chimney sweep — from $149
- Dryer vent cleaning — from $99

## How it works
1. Free phone quote 24/7
2. On-site visit — $29 flat fee charged by the matched provider (inspection + written quote; no obligation to book the job)
3. Work starts only after the homeowner approves the written quote

## Service area
Greater Houston, TX — roughly within 45 miles of Houston, including nearby suburbs (for example Houston, Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Pearland, Cypress, Spring, Pasadena, Humble, Tomball, Missouri City, League City, Friendswood, Baytown, Conroe, Richmond). Coverage is confirmed by ZIP before scheduling.
